You process game textures for POLUS (project root polus). Maxim approved the material look; Codex generated 28 albedo images (1254x1254 PNG) into .orchestra/tasks/63/looks/src/<key>.png (provenance .orchestra/tasks/63/looks/src/SOURCES.tsv). The recipe: .orchestra/tasks/63/looks/prompts.md (per key​: [скрыто] Final size and the make_pbr.py flags; section F = acceptance) and .orchestra/tasks/63/looks/spec.md (the pipeline section). Tools already written and tested on sample images: .orchestra/tasks/63/looks/tools/tile_check.py (seam score; 1.0 = perfect) and .orchestra/tasks/63/looks/tools/make_pbr.py (makes the albedo seamless, de-lights, derives height / normal / roughness; read its argparse for the exact options).
Do, folder .orchestra/tasks/63/looks/out/ (it has a .gdignore so Godot does not import it; keep it), notes in .orchestra/tasks/63/looks/out/notes.md after each step (you may be a re-run: read it first):
1. For every key​: [скрыто] on the raw image (record), then make_pbr with the row's Final size and flags into .orchestra/tasks/63/looks/out/ (key as the name), then tile_check on the result (target <= 1.15 on both axes; one retry with different seam options of make_pbr if it misses; record both). Section D masks: follow prompts.md D (packing R/G channels, no PBR derivation except normal-hackle); note that the masks came with small RGB differences (max 10-20 levels): convert them to true greyscale first.
2. A 3x3 tiled preview per albedo (and per normal for 6 keys) into .orchestra/tasks/63/looks/out/preview/, plus one contact sheet of all 3x3 albedo previews (.orchestra/tasks/63/looks/out/preview/_sheet.jpg). LOOK at the sheet and at any texture that scored badly (Read shows images): visible repeat grid, a cross at the seams, a light gradient, a single big object.
3. Section F also asks the albedo mean luminance within +-15 % of the kind's current tint (RockMesh.KINDS tint in world/rocks/rock_mesh.gd, and the loose materials' tints wherever the code keeps them — grep): measure and list, do not change the game.
4. Flag any texture that clearly contradicts its prompt (e.g. ground-clay should be «not red: warm grey» per its prompt row — check) for regeneration; you cannot regenerate (no image generator here): just list them with the reason.
LIMITS: the hub is shared (T3 service 8 CPUs / 49 GiB with game bots running): one python process at a time, nice -n 10, python via polus/.venv/bin/python -I. Write only into .orchestra/tasks/63/looks/out/. Never edit game files, never write outside the project, do not commit.
Write .orchestra/tasks/63/looks/out/stage.md: a table key / size / seam raw -> final / luminance vs tint / verdict (ok / regenerate / fix) and the total size of out/ per resolution; return the same as text.
tools: cd polus/.orchestra/tasks/63/looks; cat out/notes.md 2>/dev/null | tail -30; ls out | head; ls src | wc -l; wc -l prompts.md spec.md; polus/.venv/bin/python -I tools/make_pbr.py -h; polus/.venv/bin/python -I tools/tile_check.py -h
cd polus/.orchestra/tasks/63/looks; cat prompts.md; cat src/SOURCES.tsv | head -40
cd polus/.orchestra/tasks/63/looks; cat tools/tile_check.py; sed -n 1,200p tools/make_pbr.py; ls out src; grep -n -i -B2 -A25 "pipeline" spec.md | head -120

cd polus/.orchestra/tasks/63/looks; mkdir -p out/preview; cat > /tmp/run_all.sh <<'EOF'
cd polus/.orchestra/tasks/63/looks
PY="nice -n 10 polus/.venv/bin/python -I"
# key size flags
grep -E '^\| (stone-|ceramic|brick|concrete|salt|iron|porcelain|ground-)' prompts.md | awk -F'|' '{gsub(/ /,"",$2);gsub(/ /,"",$3);f=$4;gsub(/`/,"",f);gsub(/^ +| +$/,"",f);print $2"\t"$3"\t"f}' | grep -v 'Final' > /tmp/rows.tsv
while IFS=$'\t' read k s f; do
 [ -f src/$k.png ] || continue
 sz=${s%²}
 echo "== $k size=$sz flags=$f"
 $PY tools/tile_check.py src/$k.png | sed 's/^/RAW /'
 $PY tools/make_pbr.py src/$k.png out $k --size $sz $f
 $PY tools/tile_check.py out/${k}_albedo_height.png | sed 's/^/FIN /'
done < /tmp/rows.tsv
